% A guard: it checks a case that the fix of the files that name themselves
% with \ProvidesFile must not break.
% A file of the document named like glossary.4ht, in a subfolder, that
% names itself with \ProvidesFile{glossary.tex}, read with \include. As in
% the PDF, the file's text is in the page.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Before the included file.
\include{test-provname/include/glossary}
\end{document}
